kernel-worker CPU/count coverage or explicitly bounded omission

clock_options.formula: page base_ns + floor((guest_vPMC-current_base_count)*native_cpu_ns/native_branches), with declared carry/epoch/wrap handling
required_proof: same conditional-branch event and CPL0+CPL3 scope as W5a host counter

instruction_and_jvm_admission.direct_RDTSC_RDTSCP: Not admitted by CPUID hiding or by replacing kernel clock_gettime. Must mediate both CPL0/CPL3/direct/JIT sites or explicitly reject that executed profile. Native userspace TSC still passes through current retained msr.h else branch.
instruction_and_jvm_admission.vdso: Linux6.12 TSC mode and pvclock mode both call rdtsc_ordered; zero pvclock multiplier is not an admitted frequency/progress solution.
instruction_and_jvm_admission.JVM: Inspected OpenJDK21u Linux os::javaTimeNanos calls clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC); this is one source path, not proof that a JDK/native dependency/JIT emits no direct TSC/RNG/CPUID. Pin actual JDK/flags/JIT artifacts/CPU feature table before benchmark.
instruction_and_jvm_admission.realtime: Pinned epoch/offset separate from monotonic branch-derived clock; Linux offset/drift/jump interventions need declared semantics.
instruction_and_jvm_admission.entropy: Boot snapshots scope cold boot; they do not reseed CRNG/kernel buffers/Java DRBG/application RNG caches automatically.

timer_irq_path.proposed_kernel: tickless.config: NO_HZ_IDLE=y,HZ=100 (10ms busy tick),NO_HZ_FULL=n,one-vCPU/PREEMPT_NONE; check resolved olddefconfig, do not merely append requested options
timer_irq_path.device: Owned one-shot clockevent programming/cancellation must replace fixed 4ms PIC tick. For initial no-APIC/PIT profile, decode guest PIT control/reload and honor one-shot next deadline; no in-kernel PIT/irqchip workers.
timer_irq_path.implemented: plain interrupt request/queue/injection records; seeded busy timer target helper; prepared irq-kvm.rs ioctl adapter, not linked/compiled on Linux/executed
steps: Linux programs a timer; save nominal deadline, machine/incarnation/request and world registration
World selects seed-stream choice; compute exact count target with pinned calibrated ratio; nonzero jitter only when explicitly admitted by timing/fault policy
Stop through W5a validated mechanism; expose any natural device exits during correction as semantic boundaries
Finish pending emulated I/O completion-only; import cumulative actual guest count exactly once; publish page and process represented due events
Queue IRQ and request a legal KVM interrupt window; never force IF or clear genuine TF/debug exceptions
At KVM ready window with IF set and no STI/MOVSS shadow, call KVM_INTERRUPT; retain request if ioctl fails
Record requested deadline/count and actual injected count/RIP/time; Linux handles IRQ/tick and schedules normally
timer_irq_path.seed_sensitivity: seeded_stop alone does not switch Linux tasks. seeded_timer generates a real queued IRQ target; smoke shows different targets/records only. Linux lost-update/atomic fixture remains later integration.
timer_irq_path.correction: Debugger administration does not advance world/RNG/page publication or boundary numbering; actual guest instructions accumulate for next semantic capture. IRQ-window handling must retain the last completed semantic due request.
timer_irq_path.idle: If all participants blocked, world jumps to earliest represented deadline, publishes clocks and wakes correct VM via legal IRQ; respect ties and other machines. CONFIG_NO_HZ_IDLE does not prove actual device suppression.
timer_irq_path.acceptance_vs_handler: InjectionRecord saves the stopped count/RIP at KVM_INTERRUPT acceptance. It does not prove guest handler entry/EOI; Linux integration must observe those and distinguish queued/accepted/delivered/acknowledged states.

snapshot_contract.host_control: Recreate kernel-owned perf descriptors from pinned config; rebase logical epoch and prove continuation equality. A host FD or previous execution log is not a portable snapshot state.
snapshot_contract.coverage: Unknown hidden KVM/control state prevents a complete-state claim; narrow W5a snapshot scope remains labeled.
snapshot_contract.disk_coherence: Continuation restores exactly the paired RAM+volatile/durable/device disk image. Do not attach newer surviving disk under a stale pagecache/JVM snapshot. Reboot templates need a clean immutable boot image and proved attach/cache/CRNG reseed protocol.
snapshot_contract.seed_policy: Seed/RNG state captured or explicitly reinitialized by qualified guest/application protocol; changing only host seed does not vary warm guest cached RNG.
